mines.mine_notes: Open-pit + underground gold mine, South Carolina (100%). FY2025: 190,400 oz sold; production 13% lower YoY due to planned mine sequencing (major open-pit stripping campaign most of the year); Q4 production +86% QoQ on higher-grade ore. Q4 impairment reversal of $176.2M ($133.0M after tax) on updated life-of-mine plan and higher long-term gold price assumptions. 2026 guidance: 235,000-260,000 oz at AISC $1,500-$1,700/oz.

Open-pit + underground gold mine, Otago, South Island (100%). FY2025: 144,900 oz sold; production +17% YoY on higher-grade fresh ore from Innes Mills Phase 8; Q4 production +70% QoQ. AISC within 2025 guidance $1,800-$1,950/oz. 2026 guidance: 135,000-155,000 oz at AISC $1,950-$2,100/oz.

Underground gold mine, North Island (100%): Martha Underground and Wharekirauponga (WKP) deposits. FY2025: 73,800 oz sold; production +40% YoY on underground improvement plan. AISC in line with 2025 guidance $2,000-$2,200/oz. 2026 guidance: 60,000-75,000 oz at AISC $2,100-$2,300/oz; $340M growth+exploration capital planned in 2026 (Waihi North/acceleration).

Underground gold-copper mine, Luzon (80%-owned, controlled; production reported 100%). FY2025: 88,700 oz gold sold, copper 13.5 kt (29.8 Mlbs) sold; production -6% YoY due to underground dewatering after severe Q4 2024 weather event. AISC marginally above 2025 guidance $1,150-$1,250/oz. 2026 guidance: 135-150 kt copper equivalent at AISC $975-$1,100/oz (by-product credit basis).

notes: No FY2025 40-F exists as an annual report vehicle: OceanaGold's 40-F is a NYSE registration statement (File No. 001-43215); the Q4 & FY2025 MD&A is the authoritative annual operating disclosure, supplemented by the AIF (filed 2026-03-27) and the Feb 18, 2026 reserve statement. FY2025 consolidated: 497,600 oz gold produced (above guidance midpoint), 497,800 oz sold, average gold price $3,509/oz, copper 13.3 kt (29.3 Mlbs) produced; consolidated cash costs $1,204/oz; AISC $1,966/oz; revenue $1,893.2M (+46% YoY); net profit $628.7M attributable. 2026 consolidated guidance: 520,000-590,000 oz gold at AISC $1,750-$1,900/oz (-7%). Pure-exploration properties excluded.
